evidence.excerpt: I can't believe that we got into Y Combinator. Six years ago, I made a decision that felt like career suicide. I dropped out of India's IIT-JEE rat race, where I had spent hours studying mind-numbing subjects, knowing the entire time that I could be building something that truly helped people. When I came to the US for college, I thought things would click. Instead, I spent two years sending applications into the void while internship openings hit all-time lows. Just me, a few cool projects,…
